headline: Rupee hits two-month low, oil prices remain focal point
summary: The Indian rupee hit a two-month low on Monday as oil prices hovered around $90 a barrel. The Reserve Bank of India intervened by selling dollars into the market to steady the currency.
why: India is a large importer of crude oil, so higher oil prices widen its import bill and put pressure on the rupee; the central bank often intervenes to limit volatility.

impacts.name: Indian rupee
impacts.why: The rupee hit a two-month low against the dollar, as stated in the report.
